sources.note: Inspected owner-supplied san-isidro-schools.png on 2026-10-08; capture date unknown. URL locates the site. NHS northwest roof kept separate from ES; crown belt south of NHS roof and around its exposed forecourt, small green island and narrow entry links. Parent boundary cuts through shared canopy: trunks are allocated to their own site. No hedge distinguishable from mature crowns. Crown-width observations: Mature distinguishable clumps roughly 45-65 px across the shared image; radial/edge crowns about 35-50 px. Continuous shared-vertex triangular mapping preserves each traced surface before mapped-obstacle clipping; no nearest-roof cell jumps. Entire roof osm:way/881093803 and all its observed corners are excluded from fitting and checked against the actual final mapping. Within-roof agreement is recorded separately and does not establish cross-roof accuracy. Independent roof errors exceed five metres, so the registration gate remains unmet. One withheld roof does not establish distributed campus-wide survey accuracy; differing older mapped roof dimensions/placements are retained, not edited. The image traces and recognizable canopy groups remain the observations; surface/trunk placement clears complete mapped records. Virtual outer mesh anchors come only from the all-used-control affine and are not independent evidence. Independent excluded check errors: 2.14 m, 1.17 m, 8.29 m, 8.23 m. Visible crown centers are fitted to clear trunks within the observed crown footprint (maximum seven metres); crowns may overhang roofs and roads. Crown widths in the dense belts are estimated from image pixels against their matched local roof scale; existing circular crowns approximate irregular/elliptical image crowns. Complete mapped roofs, pitches, full-width paths/roads, water and farmland remain unchanged. Planted islands take precedence over exposed paving; ground under opaque canopy is not invented. No surveyed boundary, species, construction date or exact inventory inferred; no bitmap ships.
